title: Slumber by Blossoms

outfit_card.silhouette: Layered sheer tulle gown with a fitted corset bodice, voluminous off-shoulder draped sleeves, cascading ruffled skirt with a train, and an asymmetric petal-like capelet tier.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Gilded filigree crown with a central sapphire, surrounded by translucent ice-blue petal sprays, dangling pearl chains, and floral hairpins.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Sheer organza bodice with a high neckline, layered V-shaped gold embroidery, pearl and crystal beadwork, and puffed off-shoulder sleeves with trailing translucent ribbons.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Tiered tulle skirt with frosted floral appliqués, a ruffled bustle, pleated underlayers, and hidden shimmering lace stockings with crystal-embellished heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating luminous pearl orb, winged star motifs, cascading petal-like translucent ornaments, and a delicate starry halo effect.
